text:
deploybot: rollback initiated for release 'redwood-runtime-v1.9.2' (tag: release-20260320-0920) in prod-usw. Reason: canary kv-cache miss spike + p50 latency up 48% vs baseline. Initiating automated revert to tag release-20260228-1800 and applying tag pin. Started at 2026-03-20T09:23:20Z.

sarah: ack. thanks deploybot. mike, can you confirm whether any DB migrations were included in this release?

mike: no DB migrations in that tag, just runtime artifact + kv-cache config tweak. seeing repeated 503s from model shard pool after swap. snippet from proxy logs: 
```
[09:22:41] upstream_error: shard-12 connect timeout
[09:22:43] proxy: 503 POST /v1/generate  (req_id=abc123) latency=1023ms
[09:23:05] kv-cache: miss-rate 0.62 -> threshold 0.20
```

anya: rolling back runtime only then. will NOT touch DB. prepping node drains and will revert autoscaler overrides.

jordan: oncall here. kicking off manual rollback now. running: `deployctl rollback --env=prod-usw --from=release-20260320-0920 --to=release-20260228-1800 --pin=true --notify=eng-releases`

deploybot: rollback progress: nodes reverted 6/20 (30%). draining new pool, reattaching old model runtime images. estimated remaining time ~6m. recorded action id rbk-20260320-09-23-01.

sarah: please confirm traffic steering when you have a % cutover plan. want to avoid another full-swap flurry.

mike: plan: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over verified windows, verify p50/p95 and kv miss at each step. I'll run quick smoke: `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' https://prod-usw.api.redwood/v1/health`

pavlov: deploying health check script to edge to validate 200s, also enabling extra tracing for 10m.

deploybot: rollback progress: nodes reverted 20/20 (100%). service tag now pinned to release-20260228-1800. All route updates completed. Post-revert verification starting.

mike: smoke results: all healthy 200s across probes, p50 latency back to baseline, kv-cache miss-rate 0.18. Running a couple of prediction samples against live canary to sanity-check outputs.

sarah: thanks team. can we gate auto-rollback-on-similar for next rollout? also schedule a short postmortem with model-onboarding and infra to review the kv-cache tuning.

anya: pin persisted to cluster config: `release.pin=release-20260228-1800` and annotated deployment: `rollback-reason=kv-cache-miss-spike`. will keep pin for 24h and then release manager can decide.

jordan: closing incident in PagerDuty once postmortem scheduled. tagging SRE and ML-onboarding. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: rollback completed at 2026-03-20T09:31:08Z. action id rbk-20260320-09-23-01 closed. follow-up: created issue #infra/rollback-20260320 (link: https://redwood.internal/infra/rollback-20260320) with captured logs and artifacts.

sarah: perfect. will take owner for postmortem and coordinate with model team. thanks all. :thumbsup:
